سننت (form I)

# سَنَنْتَ (sananta) /sa.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of سَنَّ (sanna)
# سَنَنْتِ (sananti) /sa.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of سَنَّ (sanna)
# سُنِنْتُ (sunintu) /su.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of سَنَّ (sanna)
# سُنِنْتَ (suninta) /su
